$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (platform-bookkeeping-catalogue-items D1). A dormant bookkeeping source template the catalogue lists under its bookkeeping category (CatalogRegistryService::SLUG_CATEGORY_OVERRIDES). No key material: the credential is a broker reference the administrator creates when instantiating it; the live binding fails closed without it. The sandbox record of the same connector in integriq_seed_data.json is for demos only.

objects.name: PSD2 bank aggregator
objects.description: Read bank accounts and their transactions through a PSD2 account information aggregator (a GoCardless Bank Account Data style API): connect, consent, discover the accounts and sync their transactions. Set configuration.baseUrl to the aggregator's API address and create the credential named below (the aggregator's client credentials) in the credential broker, then enable.
